name: WF-170 Executed Agreement → Transaction Readiness Package & Closing Launch

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const deal=input.deal??{}; const contract=input.contract??{}; const transaction=input.transaction??{}; const identity=Boolean(deal.property_id??input.property_id)&&Boolean(deal.lead_id??input.lead_id); const executed=String(contract.execution_state??input.execution_state??'').toLowerCase()==='executed'; const evidence=Boolean(contract.signed_evidence??input.signed_evidence); const price=Number(contract.agreed_price??input.agreed_price??deal.agreed_price??0); const mao=Number(contract.effective_mao??input.effective_mao??deal.effective_mao??0); const type=String(contract.agreement_type??input.agreement_type??deal.agreement_type??'').toLowerCase(); const docs=Array.isArray(transaction.required_documents)?transaction.required_documents:[]; const supplied=Array.isArray(transaction.supplied_documents)?transaction.supplied_documents:[]; const missing=docs.filter(d=>!supplied.includes(d)); const blockers=Array.isArray(transaction.blockers)?transaction.blockers:[]; const criticalDate=transaction.closing_date??transaction.critical_closing_date??input.closing_date??null; let status='transaction_readiness_blocked',next='human_review',reason=''; if(!identity)reason='seller_property_identity_required'; else if(!executed||!evidence)reason='executed_agreement_and_signed_evidence_required'; else if(!price)reason='agreed_price_required'; else if(mao&&price>mao)reason='executed_price_exceeds_mao'; else if(!['assignment','novation','double_close'].includes(type))reason='agreement_type_required'; else if(missing.length)reason='required_transaction_documents_missing'; else if(blockers.length)reason='transaction_blockers_present'; else if(!criticalDate)reason='critical_closing_date_required'; else {status='transaction_readiness_ready';next='WF-126 closing coordination & critical date controller';reason='transaction_package_validated';} return [{json:{workflow_id:'WF-170',status,reason,deal_id:deal.id??input.deal_id??null,lead_id:deal.lead_id??input.lead_id??null,property_id:deal.property_id??input.property_id??null,contract:{agreement_type:type,execution_state:executed?'executed':'not_executed',signed_evidence_present:evidence,agreed_price:price,effective_mao:mao},transaction:{readiness_state:status==='transaction_readiness_ready'?'ready_for_closing_coordination':'blocked',required_documents:docs,supplied_documents:supplied,missing_documents:missing,blockers,critical_closing_date:criticalDate,closing_package_state:status==='transaction_readiness_ready'?'ready':'blocked'},routing:{next_route:next},safety:{executed_agreement_required:true,signed_evidence_required:true,price_must_not_exceed_mao:true,identity_required:true,blockers_prevent_closing_launch:true,human_review_for_exceptions:true},crm_activity:{event_type:'transaction_readiness_closing_launch',outcome:status,deal_id:deal.id??input.deal_id??null,lead_id:deal.lead_id??input.lead_id??null},idempotency_key:'wf-170:transaction-readiness:'+(input.event_id??deal.id??input.deal_id??'unknown')}}}];

const original=$('Validate Transaction Readiness Package').first().json; return [{json:{...original,crm_persistence:'attempted',controller_result:{status:original.status,reason:original.reason,next_route:original.routing.next_route}}}];
